# RailDrop

> Know when your train gets cheaper. Book the trip, then RailDrop watches every
> bookable Amtrak rail option across your window and says when a listed fare drops
> below what you paid.

If the live board is down, it says so. It never guesses a fare, a change fee or an
itinerary, and the final price is always confirmed on Amtrak.

## How it works

- Give it the stations, the date and what you paid.
- It opens a live fare board for the day before, your travel day and the day after.
- It checks about three times a day while a watch is open, and emails you only when
  a cheaper bookable option actually exists.
